projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: Production deployment is complete and 11-user pilot registration succeeded on 10/22. Premera plans a big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on October 22.
riskDescription.condition: A defect or integration failure may surface during mass onboarding that was not detected in the 11-user pilot.
riskDescription.consequence: The rollout could require emergency rollback, delaying go-live, eroding client confidence, and triggering penalty clauses or milestone payment disputes.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct staged rollout starting with 50-100 producers, monitor for 48 hours, then scale incrementally to reduce blast radius.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of critical defect during mass onboarding, activate emergency rollback to previous stable state within 2 hours and escalate to project board.
risks.reasoning: Big-bang approach with limited pilot testing (11 users vs. 2,500+) raises the probability of undetected edge cases. Confirmed in ALT (Watchlist risk) and EMS (RISK-011 Open/High/Medium). Single-phase rollout without staged release increases blast radius.

riskDescription.context: Data Hub total premium fields (4 new fields) have ETA 30-Jul and changes can only be completed by 5-Aug. Team is proceeding with current data mappings, and possible value discrepancies are still under discussion.
riskDescription.condition: Late delivery or schema changes in the DH premium fields may require backend refactoring after integration testing has started.
riskDescription.consequence: Rework could delay UAT entry, compress testing cycles, and increase the risk of production defects or cost overruns.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish daily handshake with Data Hub team to validate field mappings and document discrepancies by 25-Jul to allow buffer for remediation.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If DH fields are not available by 30-Jul, deploy feature toggle to disable total premium calculation and defer to Phase 2 post-UAT.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk (RISK-002, High/High, Schedule/Technical) with a hard ETA (30-Jul) and narrow remediation window (5-Aug). WSR confirms dependency is active and unresolved. Data mapping uncertainties compound the risk.

riskDescription.context: Auth0 DB connection configuration must be updated by Premera IT (Drew/Ganesh) for ACPT promotion. Ascendion lacks tenant access. ETA is 10-Jul, but this is a blocker for ACPT environment progression.
riskDescription.condition: If Premera IT delays the configuration update, ACPT deployment and integration testing may stall.
riskDescription.consequence: Testing timelines could slip, compressing UAT and increasing the likelihood of defects escaping to production.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Coordinate with Ganesh by 5-Jul to schedule Drew's availability and confirm configuration update completion by 10-Jul with daily status checks.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If configuration update is delayed beyond 10-Jul, escalate to Premera Program Manager and deploy to Dev environment for parallel testing to maintain schedule.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk (RISK-003, High/Medium, Schedule/Infrastructure) with external dependency on Premera IT. WSR confirms this is a current blocker. Mitigation is in progress but not yet closed.

riskDescription.context: AAVA connectivity from Dev instance to Premera Prod instance remains unresolved across multiple sprints. Manual workarounds are required, limiting agentic workflow capabilities.
riskDescription.condition: Continued lack of AAVA Prod connectivity may prevent the team from leveraging agentic workflows for code refactoring and testing automation.
riskDescription.consequence: Development velocity could degrade, technical debt could accumulate, and manual effort could increase cost and schedule risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Prioritize tool integration with AAVA Platform Team and Premera IT by 15-Jun, and proceed with atomic agents as interim approach to maintain velocity.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once AAVA connectivity delay exceeds 30 days, deploy external code generation tool with temporary license and upskill team to maintain productivity.
risks.reasoning: Persistent open risk (EMS RISK-001, raised 16-Mar, still open as of 22-Jul). Multiple governance reports (CES 23-Apr, 21-May, 4-Jun) confirm this is a recurring blocker. Mitigation is in progress but unresolved.

riskDescription.context: 86 CVEs detected (4 Critical, 82 High) on the alpine base image. Code coverage is 57% on backend. 190 code smells include 2 Critical and 80 Major issues.
riskDescription.condition: Unresolved Critical CVEs and low backend code coverage may allow security vulnerabilities or defects to reach production.
riskDescription.consequence: A security incident or production defect could trigger client escalation, delay go-live, or require emergency patching post-deployment.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Remediate all 4 Critical CVEs by 15-Jul and increase backend code coverage to 70% by 25-Jul through dedicated sprint focus.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Critical CVEs remain unresolved by 20-Jul, switch to alternate base image and revalidate all container deployments before UAT entry.
risks.reasoning: Confirmed in Artifacts (Sprint Demo metrics). 4 Critical CVEs and 2 Critical code smells are material. Backend coverage at 57% is below enterprise thresholds (typically 70-80%). Penetration testing is pending (WSR).

riskDescription.context: 19 scope change items are tracked in the WSR Scope Change Tracker. Multiple changes (CCS GraphQL API ownership, IaC pipeline ownership, Auth0 config ownership, dual-role requirements) were introduced mid-project.
riskDescription.condition: Additional scope changes or requirement clarifications during UAT may exceed available bandwidth and trigger formal change control.
riskDescription.consequence: Timeline or budget overruns could occur, or the client may contest additional charges, straining the commercial relationship.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement formal scope change approval process requiring Premera Program Manager sign-off before any new requirement is added to backlog.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should scope changes exceed 10% of baseline effort during UAT, invoke change control process and negotiate timeline extension or scope reduction with client.
risks.reasoning: EMS Scope RAG is Amber. WSR confirms 19 scope changes, several with Medium effort. SOW Section 14 allows change control invocation. Decision Log #32 (25-Jun) confirms new requirements must be triaged for timeline impact.

riskDescription.context: Citrix server slowness and frequent disconnections are impacting offshore team productivity. This is an active challenge confirmed in WSR 22-Jul.
riskDescription.condition: Persistent VPN and Citrix issues may continue to degrade offshore team velocity during the critical UAT and stabilization phases.
riskDescription.consequence: Sprint capacity could decline, delaying UAT entry or hypercare readiness, and increasing the risk of production defects due to compressed testing.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise priority ticket with Premera IT by 25-Jun to address Citrix slowness and implement alternate VPN solution for offshore team by 10-Jul.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix issues persist beyond 15-Jul, reallocate critical development tasks to onshore team and extend offshore working hours to compensate for lost productivity.
risks.reasoning: Confirmed in EMS (OBS-004 Open) and WSR (22-Jul Challenges). Offshore team represents 10 of 12 resources (83%). Persistent infrastructure issues across multiple sprints indicate systemic problem.

riskDescription.context: Integration testing is 0% complete as of 22-Jul. UAT test case availability and upstream data setup for E2E scenarios are pending Premera business support.
riskDescription.condition: Late availability of UAT test cases or integration test data may compress the testing window and reduce defect detection coverage.
riskDescription.consequence: Critical defects could escape to production, triggering rollback, client escalation, or post-deployment stabilization costs.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct daily coordination calls with Premera business team to prioritize UAT test case delivery and upstream data setup by 1-Aug.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If UAT test cases are not available by 5-Aug, execute integration testing using synthetic data and defer full E2E validation to hypercare phase.
risks.reasoning: WSR confirms Integration Testing is 0% and UAT is 0% as of 22-Jul. EMS DEP-013 (UAT Support) is Open with no ETA. Project end date is 31-Aug, leaving limited time for full test cycles.

riskDescription.context: Only one LLM is available in PortKey. This prevents use of a reviewer-agent and may cause task-specific underperformance, requiring additional manual review.
riskDescription.condition: LLM limitations may require additional manual review and rework of agent-generated code or test cases.
riskDescription.consequence: Development and testing velocity could degrade, increasing manual effort, cost, and schedule risk.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Document LLM limitations by task type and implement human review checkpoints for all agent-generated code before integration by 30-Jun.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When LLM output quality falls below 70% accuracy threshold, switch to manual code generation and adjust sprint estimates to reflect increased effort.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk (RISK-004, raised 16-Mar, Medium/High). WSR Open Items confirm this is an active constraint. AAVA productivity metrics (Sprint Demo 18-Jun) show partial adoption (42% dev tasks, 35% code AI-generated), indicating limited agentic leverage.

riskDescription.context: Access to Premera-specific tools (SharePoint, Azure Blob, ADO) for AAVA integration is Open with ETA 15-Jun. This dependency is unresolved.
riskDescription.condition: Continued lack of tool access may prevent full AAVA workflow integration and limit agent-based automation.
riskDescription.consequence: Development and testing efficiency could remain suboptimal, increasing manual effort and delaying delivery of agentic productivity gains.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate tool access request to Premera IT (Safal) by 10-Jun and confirm access provisioning by 15-Jun with daily status tracking.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If tool access is not granted by 20-Jun, deploy external alternative tool with temporary license and upskill team to maintain AAVA workflow continuity.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS dependency (DEP-006, ETA 15-Jun). WSR Dep #20 confirms this is unresolved. AAVA connectivity issues (RISK-001) and tool integration delays (RISK-005) are related and compound the risk.
